glm-5.3-flash-maya-s.sourceRecipe: peasantsmith/GLM-5.3-Flash-Maya-GGUF (Maya-S) on Project Maya v1.1.61, patched and contained (custom-docker-containers/vllm-node-maya)
glm-5.3-flash-maya-s.notes: Project Maya's engine, not vLLM; text only. 4 requests at once, more wait; a long prompt pauses the others while it is read (~750 tok/s). reasoning_effort is passed as sent: GLM's low, high (the default) and max; thinking stops at 32768 tokens. At max a coding task can think 38 minutes, hence requestTimeoutSeconds 3600. Quality set at 8-way: 88-89/92 at low, 83/92 at max; high not benchmarked. Leaves ~18 GiB of host memory; file cache it cannot drop shrinks its expert pool (docs/troubleshooting.md). Soak clean at 119991 prompt tokens, 2-way, default effort: 332-354 s per request. At max the thinking filled the 11K tokens left of the window and no answer came (1213 s): leave room for it.

glm-5.3-flash-maya-s-ablated.sourceRecipe: glm-5.3-flash-maya-s with the refusal direction from peasantsmith/GLM-5.3-Flash-Maya-GGUF projected out at run time (Project Maya's --ablate)
glm-5.3-flash-maya-s-ablated.notes: The weights, shape and limits of glm-5.3-flash-maya-s; Maya projects the model's refusal direction out of every answer unless the request sends "ablate": false. One of the two runs at a time. Soak clean at 119991 prompt tokens, 2-way, default effort: 348-370 s per request. Answers not benchmarked against the plain lane.

ornith-1.5-122b-nvfp4.sourceRecipe: ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-122B-NVFP4 (Qwen3.5-MoE fine-tune) with its own MTP draft on vllm-node-dflash2
ornith-1.5-122b-nvfp4.notes: Thinking is on unless reasoning_effort is none; there is no shorter level. Under 8-way load, hard problems reach 12288 tokens after ~1140 s, near the 1200 s gateway timeout for requests that do not stream. Leaves ~10 GiB of host memory under load. Soak clean at 239953 prompt tokens with thinking on, 316-355 s per request at 2-way.

huihui-qwen3.8-27b-abliterated-nvfp4.notes: Third-party requant, checked against the BF16 lane by behaviour. Sometimes follows instructions injected into tool output and invents missing tool arguments. Soak clean at 239906 prompt tokens with thinking on. Starts take ~6 min: vLLM's config hash for this checkpoint differs between processes, so the ~3.5 min FlashInfer autotune never hits its cache.
